releaseNotes:
v0.9.9

Message Recorder Machine
- Record notes while you are AFK. Turn the recorder on and set a trigger (default RMsg); the trigger is saved for the next launch.
- Other users send the trigger (with or without !) to leave a note. They can send it as many times as they want.
- Incoming whispers are recorded automatically while the machine is on, even without the trigger.
- Your own chat and whisper chrome labels (such as the word â€œwhisperâ€) are not recorded.
- Notes are grouped by sender. Expand a name to see each line with a public/whisper chip, [hh:mm] time, hover-to-read, click-to-pin, reply (placeholder), and delete.
- Recorded messages stay on this PC until you delete them.

DM Settings
- Live list of people in the room: two columns, select a name, pick a saved notice, send public or whisper.
- Works as soon as you enter the room, whether the companion is started, paused, or stopped.
- People already in the room are picked up from â€œis in the chatâ€; joins add names; leaves remove them. Leaving the room clears the list.
- User ids are read from the chat HTML so whispers can reach people who were already seated when you entered.
- You are kept off the list so you cannot whisper yourself.
- Edit Messages stores your notices locally. Delivery Method (public or whisper) applies to every send.

Also in this release
- Bot Settings is now Trigger Settings. Start Bot / Stop Bot are Start / Stop.
- Activity log uses [Event], [JOIN], [LEFT], [P.DM], and [W.DM]. Join is logged even when the companion is not started.
- AI Settings and AI Providers stay visible but locked (still in development).
